## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Evidence

Explain how the behavior was verified. Use synthetic or redacted fixtures only.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] Unknown or failed states default to protection.
- [ ] No private prompts, responses, source code, credentials, usernames, or repository paths were added.
- [ ] New metrics name their local source and coverage.
- [ ] Cleanup actions are previewed, explicit, narrowly scoped, and revalidated.
- [ ] `swift test` passes locally.
- [ ] UI changes were checked for keyboard access, contrast, and Reduce Motion where relevant.
